summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing that it terminated a securities purchase agreement executed July 27, 2026 with the Rain Foundation to issue 66,666,667 ordinary shares via private placement, payable in RAIN tokens, subject to shareholder approval. The company terminated pursuant to its rights under the agreement, halting the placement and cancelling any shareholder vote. No price per share, premium, break fee, or advisor was disclosed; the financing was consideration-in-kind rather than cash. The termination removes a major dilution overhang but also eliminates anticipated treasury funding, raising questions about near-term liquidity, the Rain protocol treasury strategy, and potential alternative financing, with risk-arb focus on dilution reversal versus cash runway.
